goal: Recognizable three-tier pagoda as one solid with stepped hipped roofs
geometry_plan: assume 1 px = 25 mm; map image (px, py) to x = (px - 320) * 25, z = (740 - py) * 25; square plan
base: ruled loft between two squares (battered stone base)
each storey: Box wall that starts slightly below the roof top under it so tiers fuse
each roof: ruled loft through three squares (eave underside, flared eave edge, small top square)
finial: Cylinder plus Cone tip; windows are surface detail and are not modelled
unknowns: roof curves simplified to straight hips
